tools.name: search_brands
tools.description: Search 1,546 Chinese AI, robot and gadget brands from CES 2026 and 2027 by product or name. Returns overseas stage, city, hero products and page URL.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Facts for one brand by id (from search_brands): overseas stage, web rank, US search volume, Google Play installs of its companion app, and 30-day news count, each with its date.

tools.name: category_check
tools.description: How many Chinese CES brands sell a product, split by overseas stage and home city, with total companion-app installs.
